items.descriptionAdvanced: Tourbet el Bey is one of the most imposing royal mausoleums in the medina of Tunis, providing a final resting place for the rulers of the Husainid dynasty and members of their families. The building, raised at the end of the 18th century, is recognizable by its characteristic green, scale-shaped tiled domes, which are an integral part of the city's historical landscape. The rich decoration of the tombs inside reflects the political power of the era and the cultural commitment of the dynasty.
